script: Parece ficção científica, mas é 100% real: Rackspace Spot breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes secrets. Uma investigação detalhada divulgada pela BleepingComputer trouxe à tona os seguintes fatos: Rackspace warned customers that hackers breached its Rackspace Spot cloud platform using compromised credentials, allowing them to deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets in customer clusters.
